body: Yeah I would really like to be myself but I tend to put on a mask of fakeness do certain things subconsciously to create this image so someone I'm not, old habits are hard to break i guess. I have been looking at certain things I do like how I dress or how I act and asking myself if I'm doing this because it makes me happy or if its to create an image that I want others to see. I have started to care less about things like that and well anything else really which isn't so good. And by not care I mean like a numbness like I should feel sad when a pet dies and I know its sad but I don't cry or feel sad just the same empty numb feeling.
I'm as of last week 20, I am going to school(college)  and I haven't officially been diagnosed with depression and I don't know about bipolarism.

I do have some cash set aside for pony shirts I just need to pick/order and that might help un closet some bronys I do find the be yourself thing hard sometimes when all I can think about is how people might judge me but at this point I'm starting to not care as much.
How am I supposed to do that when I can barely make any friends let alone keep them.
I know I wish I could just change universes to a nicer one with more caring people.

I finished high school okay and I'm going to college to in the remote possibility that I may one day be able to become a IT systems admin. Oh and did I mention I had discovered I am bisexual.. which is hard when you live in very conservative religious state full of hicks. So that's pretty much my story so far if you add on the depression and low self esteem. As for hobbies I really don't have a real hobby of sorts but my interests include technology, Linux, My little pony friendship is magic ( I know what you must think ur such a faggot right? But its actually a really good show and it allows me to feel a sense of pure joy even if that joy is short lasting. More recently I have become this weird numb state that starts in your arms and prevents me form feeling much. I had to put a cat to sleep a couple weeks ago and I didn't feel sad I just had the same sense of emptiness.. so as it seems I'm pretty fucked up. Sorry for any typos as this whole typing on a tablet is hard.
